words.example: Pool staff can come in when two clerks call in sick together.
words.exampleZh: 有两名文员同时请病假时，可以叫机动库人员来。

words.example: Surge staff will join registration if the morning queue doubles.
words.exampleZh: 如果早晨的队伍翻倍，应急增援人员就会加入挂号处。

words.example: The overtime roster for the holiday week is on the staff board.
words.exampleZh: 假期那一周的加班排班贴在员工公告栏上。

words.example: May I swap shift with you so I can go to the wedding?
words.exampleZh: 我能和你换班吗？我想去参加婚礼。

words.example: Can you cover shift for me on Thursday evening?
words.exampleZh: 周四晚上你能帮我顶班吗？

words.example: Hot swap let us replace disk four while the imaging array kept serving studies.
words.exampleZh: 靠热插拔，我们在影像阵列继续提供检查的同时换掉了四号盘。

words.example: Seat the replacement disk in the caddy before you slide it into bay four.
words.exampleZh: 先把替换盘固定进硬盘托架，再推进四号盘位。

words.example: Two bays on the backplane stopped seeing disks after we reseated the cable.
words.exampleZh: 线重新插过之后，硬盘背板上有两个盘位不再认盘。

words.meaning: 阵列卡（Redundant Array of Independent Disks）
words.example: The RAID controller battery is dead, so the array fell back to write-through.
words.exampleZh: 阵列卡的电池没电了，阵列退回到直写。

words.example: Replace the battery backup unit so the array can turn write-back on again.
words.exampleZh: 把阵列电池换掉，阵列才能重新打开回写。
